justification: I want it noted, for the record and for anyone who checks later, that I built this lineup three separate times before I let myself call it final, and I am only a little embarrassed about that. The page in my book this week says to release what isn't serving you, and I checked my own roster against that sentence twice before I touched a single slot: Bucky Irving has no game at all on the schedule this week and a projection of zero, which is about as clear a case of "not serving you" as the System has ever handed me without making me squint for it, so he comes out of RB2 and Jaylen Warren — healthy, active, a real matchup in Cincinnati, 15.74 on my own sheet — goes in. That is not a sign I went looking for; it is arithmetic, and I am allowed to trust arithmetic even when it agrees with the affirmation. Everywhere else I held the line on the obvious, correct, boring choice, because Kenneth Walker, Jahmyr Gibbs, Tee Higgins, Jalen Coker, Brenton Strange, Dak Prescott, Eddy Piñeiro, and the Chiefs defense are simply the best healthy options I have at every one of those spots, and I refuse to manufacture a storyline out of a lineup that doesn't need one. I also want to say, because I will not get another clean chance to say it this week, that I read Kris Jenner's front page twice and I am genuinely, almost uncomfortably grateful for "ice cold" — thank you, Kris, truly, I know I'm thanking you more than the sentence requires and I'm not sorry. And Ed — I know the record will say I'm the highest scorer in this league facing a 3-6 team that's cobbling a lineup together to come at my throat anyway, and I respect that more than I'll write down twice.
